items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: And even Fred Robins used it for a theme song.

ctx.x: ... Blue Harlem... This is another oddball thing. This particular tune, they wanted a guitar to start it off. And they named it Blue Harlem. So the guitar started it off with I think two choruses

And so I started it off -- real slow, funky home-town blues. A home -- with the red light outside -- slow blues -- where they turn the lights down way low. And I think we had to take a 2nd take. Cause I remember them releasing the talkin' and things like that, some other recording people like that up there -- a rehearsal. So, the second take was the one that came out & if my solo sold the record. And even Fred Robins used it for a theme song. He was a hell of a disc jockey at that time. He used it for a theme…
